Hi Kate + Tom,

Thanks for your interest in Redwood — excited to show how our inference platform can reduce token costs and improve latency for your search reranking workload. Would next Wednesday or Thursday work for a 45-minute demo + Q&A?

Here are a few slots (all in PDT):
- Wed 2026-10-28 10:00–10:45 PDT
- Wed 2026-10-28 14:00–14:45 PDT
- Thu 2026-10-29 09:30–10:15 PDT

If those don't fit, tell me the best window and I can loop in our solutions engineer. I've attached a short deck and a sheet with proposed times in your local zones.

Attaching: demo-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB); proposed-times.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,

Date: 2026-10-23T09:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood inference — scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — appreciate the options. Quick heads up: we're seeing a DST headache across teams. Our UK team will switch over the weekend of Oct 24–25 (clocks go back), while our Australia colleagues are entering daylight time in early October and then the US shift on Nov 1 will affect your West Coast time slots. So some of the times in your sheet show different local times depending on which reference you used.

For clarity:
- UK (BST → GMT) flips Oct 25 for us
- Australia (AEDT) is currently +11 and will stay +11 for our OZ folks
- We have APAC stakeholders in Sydney and NZ who can't do early morning local time next week

Could we pick an explicit UTC slot instead? Preferably two alternative UTC windows so we can confirm across London and Sydney. Also, can you include an option that avoids the first week of November because several of our US partners will be affected by the Nov 1 DST rollback and may be offline around that time.

Cheers,
Kate
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudScale Ltd.
kate.siers@cloudscale.co.uk

Date: 2026-10-26T11:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood inference — scheduling

Thanks for the note, Kate — good catch and sorry for the ambiguity. I've pulled together two explicit UTC windows that should cover London and Sydney reasonably without dragging US folks into late-night slots:

Option A: 2026-10-29 14:00–14:45 UTC (Thu) — London 14:00 BST → 13:00 GMT after Oct 25; Sydney 01:00 AEDT (next day) — note this still is late for Sydney, but OK for one APAC attendee we have listed
Option B: 2026-10-29 08:30–09:15 UTC (Thu) — London early morning, Sydney 19:30 AEDT (same day) — better for APAC evening participation

I've attached an updated timesheet with UTC columns and a calendar-invite.ics. If neither works, our SE Jonas Weber can propose splitting the session into a 30-minute focused demo for product leads and a separate 30-minute ops/deep-dive for the APAC engineering team.

Attaching: proposed-times.xlsx (updated), calendar-invite.ics

Looping in Jonas and Laura to confirm availability.

Best,
Marissa
